A '''tool demagnitizer''' was a type of [[Color/Legends|bronze]]-colored, disc-shaped rack for micro-tools mounted on a similarly colored circular base plate. Four copper-colored wire coils then extended up from the rack.<ref name="TPM VD" /> The [[Slavery/Legends|enslaved]] [[Human/Legends|Human]] [[Anakin Skywalker/Legends|Anakin Skywalker]] used a tabletop tool demagnitizer that also doubled as a tool rack for small instruments, as he was required to do delicate work with precision tools when restoring machinery.<ref name="Expanded">''[[Star Wars: The Phantom Menace: The Expanded Visual Dictionary]]''</ref> The device sat in a wall alcove opposite the workstation of Skywalker's [[Parent/Legends|mother]], [[Shmi Skywalker Lars/Legends|Shmi Skywalker]], in the [[Skywalker home/Legends|Skywalker home]]<ref name="TPM" /> on [[Slave Quarters Row/Legends|Slave Quarters Row]] in the [[City/Legends|city]] of [[Mos Espa/Legends|Mos Espa]]<ref name="TPM VD" /> on the [[planet]] [[Tatooine]]. It was left on the shelf when Anakin packed his belongings and said farewell to his [[Gender/Legends|mother]] before leaving Tatooine<ref name="TPM" /> in [[32 BBY/Legends|32 BBY]].<ref name="Date">''[[The New Essential Chronology]]'' dates the events of {{Film|I}} to [[32 BBY/Legends|32 BBY]].</ref>

==Behind the scenes==
An tool demagnitizer appeared in the [[prequel trilogy]] film [[Star Wars: Episode I The Phantom Menace|''Star Wars'': Episode I ''The Phantom Menace'']],<ref name="TPM" /> which was released on [[May 19]], [[1999]].<ref name="Year by Year">''[[Star Wars Year By Year: A Visual History, Updated and Expanded Edition]]''</ref> It was identified in the reference book [[Star Wars: Episode I: The Visual Dictionary|''Star Wars: Episode I The Visual Dictionary'']], which was written by [[David West Reynolds (real person)|David West Reynolds]]<ref name="TPM VD" /> and released on [[May 26]], 1999.<ref name="Amazon">{{CollectorCite|6|Books with Bite}}</ref>
